name: Joking
overview: Scripture acknowledges the value of a joyful heart as beneficial like medicine, yet it warns against careless or harmful speech, including coarse joking, which can cause damage as destructive as firebrands. While humor and lightheartedness have their place, believers are reminded that every idle word will be accounted for on the day of judgment, urging wisdom and restraint. The Word of God serves as a guiding light to keep our speech and attitudes aligned with godly love, especially as increasing sin threatens to harden hearts.
